# Data360 Beast Full Agent Context

Data360 Beast is a curated Salesforce Data 360 skill pack for agentic IDEs.
It is not a Salesforce docs mirror. It gives agents a top-level Beast router,
16 specialist Data 360 skills, a source hierarchy, phase router, API workflow,
and validation contract.

## Entry Points

- Homepage: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/
- Repository: https://github.com/architect-bertie/data360beast
- Skill pack: https://github.com/architect-bertie/data360beast/tree/main/skills
- Compact LLM file: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/llms.txt
- Skill map: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/skills.md
- MCP dependencies: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/mcp-dependencies.md
- Help index: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/data360/help/index.md
- Developer Guide index: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/data360/developer/index.md
- Developer learning map: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/data360/developer/learning-map.md
- Architecture engine map: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/data360/architecture-engine-map.md
- Interoperability decision map: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/data360/interoperability-decision-map.md
- Manifest: https://architect-bertie.github.io/data360beast/agent-manifest.json

## Skills

- `data360beast`: top-level router and proof contract.
- `sf-datacloud`: cross-phase orchestration.
- `sf-datacloud-connectapi`: Connect REST API, Apex ConnectApi, OpenAPI lookup.
- `sf-datacloud-connect`: connectors and connections.
- `sf-datacloud-prepare`: streams, DLOs, transforms.
- `sf-datacloud-harmonize`: DMOs, mappings, identity, data graphs.
- `sf-datacloud-governance`: data spaces, access, policies, masking.
- `sf-datacloud-retrieve`: SQL, profile, metadata.
- `sf-datacloud-calculated-insights`: calculated and streaming insights.
- `sf-datacloud-segment`: segments, counts, publish proof.
- `sf-datacloud-act`: activations and data action delivery.
- `sf-datacloud-automation`: flows, events, monitoring.
- `sf-datacloud-semantic-layer`: semantic models and metrics.
- `sf-datacloud-ai-models`: AI models and model outputs.
- `sf-datacloud-unstructured-retrieval`: search indexes and retrievers.
- `sf-datacloud-analytics`: reports, dashboards, analytics.
- `sf-datacloud-metadata-agentic`: metadata semantics for agents.

## Source Hierarchy

1. User-provided target org, files, data space, API version, and business goal.
2. Official Salesforce docs fetched on demand.
3. User-supplied or locally available Data 360 Connect API OpenAPI spec.
4. Data360 Beast cookbook and scorecard.
5. Live org validation in an explicitly authorized org.

## Official Doc Indexes

- 77 Salesforce Help pages are indexed at `/data360/help/index.md`.
- 23 Salesforce Developer Guide pages are indexed at `/data360/developer/index.md`.
- Raw crawled docs and local summaries are not published; fetch exact official
  pages on demand before making source-sensitive claims.

## Companion MCP Services

- `sf-docs`: install from https://github.com/kvirtue123/sf-docs-mcp when the
  agent needs official Salesforce Help or Developer docs as clean Markdown.
- `data360`: install from https://github.com/forcedotcom/d360-mcp-server when
  the agent needs authorized live Data 360 Connect API operations through
  `search`, `payload_examples`, and `execute`.
- Keep caches, access tokens, client secrets, and org metadata local. Do not
  publish them in this repository.

## Operating Loop

1. Classify the phase.
2. Identify the object layer and likely execution plane.
3. For external data, choose ingestion, live query, accelerated query, file federation, or hybrid.
4. Identify the proof target.
5. Fetch official docs on demand.
6. Search OpenAPI for the API shape.
7. Apply the cookbook.
8. Validate in org when authorized.
9. Label confidence as documented, tested, or inferred.

## Phase Router

- Connect: connectors, connections, schema, refresh, ingestion setup.
- Prepare: data streams, DLOs, transforms, document processing.
- Harmonize: DMOs, mappings, relationships, identity resolution, data graphs.
- Govern: data spaces, classifications, tags, access policies, security.
- Retrieve: Query SQL, Query v2, Profile API, metadata discovery.
- Insight: calculated insights, streaming insights, SQL validation.
- Semantic: semantic models, metrics, dimensions, shared dimensions.
- AI/Search: search indexes, retrievers, unstructured retrieval, grounding.
- Segment: segment create/read/publish/count, DBT segments, membership proof.
- Act: activation targets, activations, data action targets, data actions.
- Automation: triggered flows, events, activation-triggered flows, monitoring.

## Live-Tested Cookbook Notes

- Data space and metadata discovery are safe first checks.
- Query SQL and Profile API provide useful proof for data and metadata.
- Query, transform, segment, analytics, activation, and orchestration surfaces
  can validate and execute through different paths; proof must match the
  target surface.
- For interoperability, choose the pattern from freshness, governance owner,
  access pattern, data volume, and cost/I/O before designing connectors or SQL.
- DBT segment create worked with `includeDbt.models.models[]`.
- DBT segment readback can normalize to `includeDbt.models[]`.
- Approximate segment count can fail when the feature is disabled.
- Segment members depend on a delta window; status and count readback are better
  first proofs.
- Data action target and data action create were validated in lab.
- Activation target create/read was validated by returned ID.
- Search index and calculated insight list were explored, but creation recipes
  require enabled assets before promotion.

## Public Boundary

This repository intentionally excludes raw Salesforce Help exports, generated
caches, lab data, credentials, and org-specific metadata. Agents should fetch
official docs on demand and use this repository as the curated operating layer.

- Connect API readiness: 9.7/10
- Core Data 360 architecture: 9.3/10
- Governance and data spaces: 9.0/10
- Segment, act, automation: 9.2/10
- Overall Beast mode: 9.6/10
